thesis: The episode introduces Grug, an anonymous MEV researcher on the Ethereum blockchain, who explains the basic architecture of the Ethereum blockchain and how its structure allows for the emergence of MEV strategies like sandwich attacks, arbitrage, and liquidations. Grug discusses criteria for identifying profitable MEV strategies, provides examples of long-tail approaches he has deployed, and addresses associated risks, the pro-cyclical nature of these strategies, the role of retail flow, and the impact of Alt-L1s and L2s on MEV.
